summary.text: Frank Tomaszewski has served in the Alaska House of Representatives for District 34 since 2023.

paragraphs.text: According to Tomaszewski's legislative biography, the representative has lived in the Fairbanks area for 45 years, in Fox from 1979 to 1991 and in Fairbanks since 1991.
The biography lists Tomaszewski as a Fairbanks North Star Borough Assembly member, an electrical journeyman and administrator, and a general contractor.
